subject.title: feat(cli): list and resolve pending approvals headlessly

question: Should OpenClaw core support headless cross-kind approval enumeration and resolution, with the proposed `operator.admin`/`operator.approvals` scope contract, as a stable operator CLI interface?
rationale: This is a new remote-execution-adjacent core capability whose least-privilege and loopback/shared-auth behavior are product and security-boundary choices, not a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Sponsor the headless operator CLI
options.body: Approve the core CLI direction, then require a rebase and redacted real-Gateway proof for both normal and restricted scope behavior before merge.

options.title: Narrow the interface first
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers define a less-privileged enumeration or resolution contract and update the implementation to that decision.

options.title: Keep approvals chat-only
options.body: Decline a core headless command surface and retain approval resolution through existing interactive channels.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the headless operator CLI
recommendation.body: Approve the core CLI direction, then require a rebase and redacted real-Gateway proof for both normal and restricted scope behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this contributor to the proposed CLI and its authorization hardening; an explicit repository owner should ultimately sponsor or redirect the product decision.
